title: Similar mall world dreams
content: Stumbled across the mall world phenomenon a few months ago, and the more I read the more I am convinced we are all tapping into some sort of unified, agreed upon, dimensional framework for consciousness to exist in. For instance, my mall world dreams always consist of a large hotel, with a casino inside, near the ocean, near an airport, with winding highways, and my partner has also dreamt of the actual mall as well. We agreed we were in the same place when we talked about a large roundabout store in the middle of the second story of the mall. Anyone else have any other similarities?
